title: AI Posture Declaration
description: A machine-readable AI Posture assertion published at /.well-known/ai-posture.json.

spec_version.description: Version of the AI Posture specification under which this declaration was produced.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which the declaration was produced.

next_review.description: ISO 8601 date by which the declaring organization intends to reissue or revise this declaration. Declarations past this date are stale.

domain.description: Canonical domain URI of the declaring organization.

scope.description: Optional scope label when the assertion covers less than the full organization.

assertion_basis.description: How the declaration was produced. self-estimate: derived from the pre-assessment. self-assertion: organization applied the rubric directly. verified: reserved, MUST NOT be used until a verification process is specified.

level.description: Aggregate AI Posture level (minimum of in-scope vectors). Null when all vectors are N/A.

constraining_vectors.description: Vector or vectors at the minimum level. Empty when all vectors are N/A.

evidence.description: Optional per-vector arrays of artifact URIs supporting the level claims. Does not confer verification.

in_scope.description: Whether this vector is in scope for the declaring organization.

level.description: Vector maturity level. Null when in_scope is false.

at_level_since.description: ISO 8601 date when the organization reached this level. Null for vectors newly scored in this declaration. Duration at level is a trust signal, not a gate.

posterior.description: Optional probability distribution over levels 0-5, present when assertion_basis is self-estimate.

evidence_list.description: Array of URIs pointing to artifacts supporting the vector's level claim.
